name: malo-browser
description: Scripted browser demo tool and agent browser runtime: a visible Electron stage for live web demos, hidden 1080p30 recording with evidence files, a director console and a loopback control API, plus a daemon handing out port leases with isolated, profile-backed browser sessions exposing 26 session tools (including network capture).

interface.shortDescription: Scripted browser demos and an agent browser runtime
interface.longDescription: Malo Browser runs a scripted Electron stage for live web demos, hidden 1920x1080@30fps recording with evidence files, a React director console and a loopback control API. Its daemon hands out loopback port leases; each lease hosts isolated, profile-backed browser sessions with persistent login state and exposes 26 session tools (including network capture), so several agents can drive separate sessions at the same time.
